Each source instance preserves independent fan/strip primitive topology, malformed frequency or missing instance payload fail closed, DX9Ex gamepad and FFB unaffected.
Packed vertex and instance data regression with positive, negative overflow and source static linkage passes along with unchanged mandatory Fast, Backend, Windows Build, OpenXR and HUD Gates.
